label: Exit Interview Pattern Analyzer
description: Analyzes patterns across multiple exit interview responses to identify systemic issues, retention risks, and organizational health signals.

guidedInputs.label: Exit interview responses
guidedInputs.description: Paste anonymised exit interview responses. Label each by role level and department, not name.
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Leaver 1 (Manager, Compliance): Primary reason for leaving: better compensation at competitor. Secondary comments: 'management style has become very top-down, less collaborative than when I joined. Work-life balance has deteriorated in the last 12 months.'
Leaver 2 (Analyst, Risk): Primary reason: career growth opportunity. Comments: 'no clear promotion path, same role for 3 years. Training budget was cut and I felt stagnant.'
Leaver 3 (Director, Legal): Primary reason: personal (relocation). Comments: 'no major issues, would recommend as employer.'

guidedInputs.label: Organisational context (optional)
guidedInputs.description: Any relevant context: restructuring, leadership changes, market conditions, headcount targets.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Organisation underwent a restructuring in Q2 2024. New CEO appointed in January 2024. Voluntary attrition rate was 14% (up from 9% prior year). Industry benchmark attrition is approximately 11%.
